events.verdict: Oubre Jr. (WAS) makes marginal contact with Lowry (TOR) prior to the start of his upward shooting motion.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wall (WAS) takes a third step after his gather prior to the beginning of his upward shooting motion.
Siakam (TOR) jumps A to B and makes contact to the body of Wall (WAS) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Morris (WAS) wraps Ibaka (TOR) around the waist and keeps his hand there.
[Observable in enhanced video] Ibaka (TOR) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Morris (WAS) places his hand on Lowry's (TOR) hip as he drives to the basket, but the contact is marginal and does not affect the shot attempt.
Morris (WAS) engages and disengages with Lowry (TOR) in the lane without affecting his ability to defend the play.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined Lowry (TOR) was inside the restricted area at the time of the contact with Wall (WAS) and a shooting foul is called.
Following the stoppage during the loose ball situation, the game is restarted with a jump ball at center circle between any two jumpers. The shot clock is set to 24.
Ibaka (TOR) establishes himself in a screening position in Wall's (WAS) path, but continues moving into Wall and delivers the contact.
Prior to the inbound pass, Morris (WAS) places his hand on Ibaka (TOR) and briefly grasps his jersey with no effect on his FOM.
Oubre Jr. (WAS) makes marginal contact with VanVleet's (TOR) arm just prior to his upward shooting motion that does not affect his shot attempt.
VanVleet (TOR) affects Wall's (WAS) driving shot attempt by making contact with his arms as he begins his upward shooting motion.
VanVleet (TOR) makes marginal contact with Wall (WAS) in the backcourt that does not cause him to lose control of the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wall (WAS) steps OOB prior to releasing the pass.
